leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an ADR template with required sections for decision context, consequences, and status tracking
Apply technical debt assessment criteria to categorize and prioritize codebase issues
Configure estimation models using story points and velocity calculations for sprint planning
Implement a debt tracking system that links technical issues to business impact metrics
Manipulate ADR lifecycle states to reflect decision progression from proposed to accepted or superseded
Integrate estimation techniques with team capacity planning for realistic project timelines
Update technical debt registers with mitigation strategies and resource allocation plans
